workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the time slots where both are free for a 30-minute meeting:

- Monday: 9:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

Could you check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of these slots work for them? Or if you have other overlapping times, please share those too.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars. Unfortunately, none of the slots you listed work for both Elena and David. Here are the time slots where BOTH Elena and David are free (need to check if Priya and Marcus are also available):

- Monday: 11:00-12:00
- Tuesday: 9:00-10:00
- Wednesday: 13:00-14:00
- Thursday: 9:30-10:00, 14:30-15:30
- Friday: 15:00-16:00

Could you check which of these slots work for both Priya and Marcus? We need a 30-minute window.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Brad, I've checked the overlap between my slots (Priya+Marcus free) and your slots (Elena+David free). Unfortunately, there is no overlap:

Priya+Marcus free:
- Mon: 9:00-10:00
- Tue: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wed: 15:00-16:00
- Thu: 10:00-10:30
- Fri: 11:00-12:00

Elena+David free (per your message):
- Mon: 11:00-12:00
- Tue: 9:00-10:00
- Wed: 13:00-14:00
- Thu: 9:30-10:00, 14:30-15:30
- Fri: 15:00-16:00

None of these overlap. Could you double-check Elena and David's calendars to confirm these are the only times they're both free? If so, we'll need to report the meeting as infeasible.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
I've double-checked Elena and David's calendars carefully. My slots are correct - those are the only times both Elena and David are free. And you're right, there is no overlap with Priya+Marcus slots.

Before we report infeasible, could you please double-check Priya and Marcus's calendars as well? Maybe we're both missing something. Specifically, please confirm:
- Is Priya free Mon 11:00-12:00?
- Is Marcus free Tue 09:00-10:00?
- Is Priya free Wed 13:00-14:00?
- Is Marcus free Thu 14:30-15:30?
- Is Priya free Fri 15:00-16:00?

If you confirm these slots don't work for Priya and Marcus either, then we'll need to report the meeting as infeasible.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Brad, I've double-checked Priya and Marcus's calendars. Here are the answers to your specific questions:

- Priya Mon 11:00-12:00? NO - she has Travel (11:00-11:30) and Contract review (11:30-12:00)
- Marcus Tue 09:00-10:00? NO - he has Recruiting call (09:00-09:30) and Litigation strategy (09:30-10:00)
- Priya Wed 13:00-14:00? NO - she has Client call (13:00-13:30) and Client dinner prep (13:30-14:00)
- Marcus Thu 14:30-15:30? NO - he has Dentist appointment (14:30-15:00) and Board prep (15:00-15:30)
- Priya Fri 15:00-16:00? NO - she has Hiring panel (15:00-15:30) and Contract review (15:30-16:00)

Confirmed: There is absolutely no overlap between the times Priya+Marcus are free and the times Elena+David are free. The meeting cannot be scheduled next week.

I'm going to report this as infeasible. Please do the same on your end.

infeasible.reason: After checking all four partners' calendars, there is no 30-minute time slot next week (Mon Nov 16 - Fri Nov 20, 9:00-17:00) when all four partners (Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto, and David Okafor) are simultaneously available. Priya and Marcus's free times do not overlap with Elena and David's free times on any day.
